title: IMU
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Sensor Models/IMU.md
text: IMU simulation model, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Axis skew (%)} sets Sensor axes skew; {Reference frame} sets the navigation reference frame, {Specify temperature from input port}, {Temperature ( o C)} sets the operating temperature of IMU, {Specify magnetic field from input port}, {Magnetic field (NED)} sets the magnetic field vector expressed in NED navigation, {MagneticField (ENU)} sets the magnetic field vector expressed in ENU navigation, {Seed} sets the initial seed for randomization, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Maximum readings (m/s 2 )} sets the maximum sensor reading, {Resolution ((m/s 2 )/LSB)} sets the resolution of sensor measurements, {Constant offset bias (m/s 2 )} sets the constant sensor offset bias, {Velocity random walk (m/s 2 /√Hz)}, {Bias Instability (m/s 2 )} sets the instability of the bias offset, {Bias instability filter numerator coefficients}, {Bias instability filter denominator coefficients}, {Acceleration random walk ((m/s 2 )(√Hz))}, {Noise Type} sets the type of random, {Bias from temperature ((m/s 2 )/℃)} sets the sensor bias from temperature, {Temperature scale factor (%/℃)} scales factor error from temperature, {Maximum readings (rad/s)} sets the maximum sensor reading, {Resolution ((rad/s)/LSB)} sets the resolution of sensor measurements, {Constant offset bias (rad/s)} sets the constant sensor offset bias, {Bias from acceleration ((rad/s)/(m/s 2 )} sets the sensor bias from linear acceleration, {Angle random walk ((rad/s)/(√Hz))}, {Bias Instability (rad/s)} sets the instability of the bias offset, {Rate random walk ((rad/s)(√Hz))} sets the integrated white noise of sensor, {Bias from temperature ((rad/s)/℃)} sets the sensor bias from temperature, {Maximum readings (μT)} sets the maximum sensor reading, {Resolution ((μT)/LSB)} sets the resolution of sensor measurements, {Constant offset bias (μT)} sets the constant sensor offset bias, {White noise PSD (μT/√Hz)} sets the power spectral density of sensor noise, {Bias Instability (μT)} sets the instability of the bias offset, {Random walk ((μT)*√Hz)} sets the integrated white noise of sensor and {Bias from temperature (μT/℃)} sets the sensor bias from temperature. Values come from the instance.
